name: Flyerimage
author: thousand31

sections.description:
Flyerimage lets you schedule, manage, and display flyer-style content and modal popups across your WordPress site — all from a simple dashboard.
It’s perfect for campaign managers, marketers, event organizers, and site owners, and includes flexible timing controls so you show the right message at the right moment.

Key Features

  • Create and manage flyers and leaflet content
  • Schedule display by time or condition (e.g., show only on specific pages)
  • Built-in modal popup support
  • Clean admin UI powered by modern tools
  • Works seamlessly within WordPress

How It Helps You

  • Run scheduled campaigns without code
  • Increase visibility for events, promotions, and announcements
  • Target visitors based on timing and context

License

Flyerimage is free software, licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
